34537022.model_family: random forest / SVM / ANN (ensemble of classifiers)
34537022.body_region: hand and wrist (finger, hand, ankle joints)
34537022.clinical_problem: Distinguishing which clinical and hand/wrist radiographic features best diagnose Kashin-Beck disease, an endemic osteochondropathy, in adolescents
34537022.patient_population: 400 adolescents with Kashin-Beck disease and 400 without
34537022.model_description: Combines manually extracted clinical exam findings with radiographic changes on hand X-rays (26 candidate features) as input to random forest, ANN, SVM and linear regression classifiers, with several feature-selection methods, to output a KBD diagnosis
34537022.headline_result: Best 10-feature subset gave high sensitivity, specificity, accuracy and AUC across classifiers (exact values not given in abstract)

34659686.model_family: unclear (described only as an 'artificial intelligence algorithm' with a diffusion filter for image denoising)
34659686.clinical_problem: Predicting fetal distress in pregnancies complicated by pregnancy-induced hypertension using Doppler ultrasound combined with fetal heart monitoring
34659686.patient_population: 120 pregnant women (88 with PIH and fetal distress, 32 healthy controls)
34659686.model_description: An AI-guided diffusion-filter algorithm denoises Doppler ultrasound images; combined Doppler ultrasound and fetal heart monitoring parameters (PI, RI, S/D) are compared between distressed and healthy pregnancies to flag fetal distress
34659686.headline_result: 73.3% of fetal distress cases detected by combined US + heart monitoring vs 26.7% by heart monitoring alone (P<0.05)
34659686.study_design: retrospective observational study; NOTE: this article has been formally retracted

34735483.clinical_problem: Automatically diagnosing pneumonia, the leading infectious cause of death in children under five, from chest X-rays
34735483.patient_population: Pediatric chest X-ray dataset (children with and without pneumonia)
34735483.model_description: Chest X-ray images are fed through an Xception network for deep feature extraction, and the extracted features pass to an LSTM module that selects the most discriminative features to classify the image as pneumonia or normal
34735483.dataset_size: not stated (existing pediatric pneumonia chest X-ray dataset)

35049843.clinical_problem: Early detection of osteosarcoma, a bone cancer more common in children than adults, and its lung metastases from CT-derived images
35049843.patient_population: Osteosarcoma patients from Lerdsin Hospital (exact ages not stated)
35049843.model_description: CT images converted to common file formats (BMP/JPG/PNG) are classified as osteosarcoma-positive or -negative by three pretrained CNNs (VGG-16, ResNet-50, MobileNet-V2)
35049843.headline_result: VGG-16 was the most robust model across image formats; PNG was the preferred format (exact accuracy/F1 not given in abstract)

31254271.model_family: machine learning pipeline (unspecified classifier) on Jacobian-of-deformation and intensity features
31254271.clinical_problem: Identifying imaging biomarkers that predict post-operative cerebellar mutism syndrome after posterior fossa tumor resection in children
31254271.patient_population: Children undergoing longitudinal MRI across treatment for posterior fossa brain tumors
31254271.model_description: A fully automated pipeline interpolates multi-slice 2D MRI into 4D volumetric data, computes a Jacobian-of-deformation metric and grey-level intensity changes over time, and applies machine learning to flag imaging biomarkers associated with POPCMS development
31254271.dataset_size: not stated exactly (longitudinal pediatric MRI cohort)
31254271.headline_result: Six candidate imaging biomarkers automatically identified as associated with POPCMS development
31254271.study_design: retrospective, hypothesis-free automated biomarker discovery study

32396089.model_family: nonlocal residual neural network + random forest
32396089.clinical_problem: Automatically flagging poor-quality pediatric MRI slices/volumes in real time to reduce the need for repeat scans
32396089.patient_population: Pediatric T1- and T2-weighted MRI scans
32396089.model_description: A nonlocal residual neural network (NR-Net) rates each MRI slice as pass/questionable/fail, refined by semi-supervised learning and iterative self-training; a random forest agglomerates slice ratings into a volume-level quality score
32396089.dataset_size: small quality-annotated training set (exact n not stated)
32396089.headline_result: Near-perfect accuracy with real-time (millisecond-per-volume) quality assessment
32396089.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and validation study

32489518.clinical_problem: Automatically discovering anatomical landmarks that sonographers visually attend to during fetal neurosonography, to support image registration
32489518.patient_population: Fetal ultrasound scans with sonographer eye-gaze tracking
32489518.model_description: A CNN is trained to predict sonographer gaze-point (saliency) maps from fetal ultrasound video frames; local maxima of the predicted saliency maps become candidate anatomical landmarks, matched across images via CNN feature clustering
32489518.dataset_size: not stated exactly (full-length clinical fetal ultrasound scans)
32489518.headline_result: Landmark alignment errors of 4.1%-10.9% of fetal head long-axis length when used for affine registration

32711819.clinical_problem: How accurately behavioral and neuroimaging measures in infancy/toddlerhood predict a later diagnosis of autism spectrum disorder
32711819.patient_population: Infants and toddlers under 3 years old at high risk for or later diagnosed with ASD
32711819.model_description: Systematic review synthesizing 17 neuroimaging and 43 behavioral studies that used classifiers (logistic regression, linear discriminant analysis, decision trees, SVM, deep learning) on brain volumetric/functional MRI and behavioral features to predict later ASD diagnosis
32711819.headline_result: Neuroimaging study accuracy ranged 61%-94%; behavioral study sensitivity 20%-100%, specificity 48%-100%

32879655.clinical_problem: Detecting and segmenting brain lesions (tubers) in children with tuberous sclerosis complex despite incomplete/noisy expert annotations
32879655.patient_population: 165 scans of children with tuberous sclerosis complex from five centers
32879655.model_description: A CNN is trained to segment brain lesions on MRI while simultaneously identifying false-negative (missed) labels in the noisy training annotations, using prediction uncertainty and prior knowledge of lesion size/features to correct the training set
32879655.headline_result: Improved lesion detection and segmentation accuracy over a baseline CNN trained on noisy labels (exact metric not given in abstract)

32920605.clinical_problem: Whether diffusion MRI white-matter tract structure related to memory and emotion differs in very preterm children and can classify/predict outcomes
32920605.patient_population: 144 very preterm children and 33 full-term controls at age 7 years
32920605.model_description: Diffusion MRI tractography measures (diffusivities, neurite density/orientation dispersion, fractional anisotropy) from five white-matter tracts are fed into support vector classification models to distinguish very preterm from full-term children, and support vector regression to predict memory/emotional outcomes
32920605.headline_result: SVM tract-based models significantly classified preterm vs. full-term children; SVM regression did not significantly predict memory/emotional outcomes
32920605.study_design: prospective cohort study with case-control MRI analysis

33030350.clinical_problem: Inferring functional brain network topology (connectivity) from resting-state fMRI, illustrated in children/adolescents with ADHD
33030350.patient_population: 134 typically developing children, 75 ADHD-inattentive and 93 ADHD-combined children/adolescents
33030350.model_description: An extremely-randomized-trees algorithm estimates each brain region's contribution to others from fMRI time series to build a whole-brain connectivity adjacency matrix, without arbitrary correlation thresholds, then compares graph metrics between ADHD subtypes
33030350.dataset_size: 302 children/adolescents (134 TD, 75 ADHD-inattentive, 93 ADHD-combined) plus simulated data from 50 subjects
33030350.headline_result: BrainNET identified significant group differences in graph metrics (p<0.05) that correlation and partial correlation methods missed
33030350.study_design: retrospective method-development and cohort comparison study

33644782.clinical_problem: Correcting inter-slice fetal motion in 2D fetal brain MRI to enable accurate 3D volume reconstruction
33644782.model_description: A two-stage CNN jointly predicts each 2D slice's 3D motion (transformation) parameters and its tissue segmentation, using anatomy-derived distance maps to guide a coarse-to-fine correction of motion for 3D fetal brain reconstruction
33644782.headline_result: Reduced motion-prediction error and improved tissue segmentation versus state-of-the-art comparison methods (exact numbers not given in abstract)

33733173.clinical_problem: Screening for intrauterine growth restriction in a low-resource rural setting using gestational-age estimates from low-cost one-dimensional Doppler ultrasound and blood pressure, instead of standard biometry
33733173.patient_population: 114 pregnant women in rural Guatemala; test set of 28 normal-weight and 25 low-birth-weight newborns
33733173.model_description: Features derived from low-cost one-dimensional Doppler ultrasound recordings and maternal blood pressure are input to a support vector regression model that estimates gestational age; a lower-than-expected estimate flags possible IUGR
33733173.headline_result: Mean absolute GA error 0.72 months (normal weight) and 1.01 months (low birth weight) vs. last menstrual period

31942569.clinical_problem: Building memory- and compute-efficient models to classify standard fetal ultrasound planes (abdomen, head, femur) for point-of-care use
31942569.patient_population: Fetal ultrasound video with sonographer gaze tracking
31942569.model_description: Ultrasound video is combined with sonographer point-of-gaze tracking to train compact 'student' CNNs (via teacher-student distillation) that classify standard fetal planes (abdomen, head, femur) at a fraction of the memory of full-sized models
31942569.headline_result: Best memory-efficient models performed within 5% of conventional models 1000x larger

32547892.model_family: multivariate data-driven models with stability selection (feature selection); graph mining
32547892.clinical_problem: Predicting delayed neurocognitive effects (attention, memory, processing speed) after therapy for childhood acute lymphoblastic leukemia, early using imaging
32547892.patient_population: Childhood ALL survivors (exact n not stated in abstract)
32547892.model_description: Diffusion tensor MRI tractography, brain morphometry, behavioral phenotype and demographic data are combined with 'stability selection' feature selection and machine learning/graph mining to predict late neurocognitive outcomes of childhood ALL therapy
32547892.headline_result: 13%-26% improved prediction accuracy over existing models

29851653.clinical_problem: Fully automated classification of trunk tissues (lung, fat, muscle, solid organ, blood/bowel contrast, bone) on contrast-enhanced CT, including distinguishing bone from contrast
29851653.patient_population: Contrast-enhanced NCAP CT scans from adult and pediatric patients
29851653.model_description: A random forest classifier trained on 28 2D and 12 3D image filters plus one spatial feature assigns each CT voxel to one of six tissue classes (lung, fat, muscle, solid organ, blood/bowel contrast, bone)
29851653.dataset_size: 28 training CT scans (4 adult, 3 pediatric) plus 70 additional manually classified images; tested on 21 manually classified slices
29851653.headline_result: Dice similarity coefficients ranged 0.90 (bone) to 0.98 (lung) at trained locations
29851653.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and validation study

29107355.clinical_problem: Reducing shadowing artifact in 3D fetal brain ultrasound to improve visibility of brain structures for monitoring and diagnosis of brain defects
29107355.patient_population: Phantom and real fetal head ultrasound volumes
29107355.model_description: An SVM trained on textural features assigns weights (posterior probabilities of brain tissue vs. shadow) used to spatially compound multiple 3D fetal head ultrasound projections into a single clearer volume
29107355.dataset_size: not stated exactly (phantom + real fetal head volumes)
29107355.headline_result: Signal-to-noise ratio improved up to 35% and contrast-to-noise ratio up to 135% versus prior compounding methods
29107355.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and phantom/clinical validation study

29226176.clinical_problem: Segmenting the lung across the breathing cycle on cine MRI to track respiratory muscle involvement in Duchenne muscular dystrophy
29226176.patient_population: 31 young boys (15 with DMD, 16 age-matched healthy controls)
29226176.model_description: A holistically nested CNN, trained on one manually segmented frame per subject, performs image-to-image lung segmentation across an entire cine MRI breathing-cycle sequence in axial, sagittal and coronal planes
29226176.headline_result: Dice similarity coefficients of roughly 0.9 across sagittal, axial and coronal views (exact figures obscured in abstract formulas)
29226176.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and validation study

29250565.clinical_problem: Automating the initial rough alignment step of image-guided cochlear implant programming by localizing anatomical landmarks on head CT
29250565.patient_population: Adult and pediatric cochlear implant recipients
29250565.model_description: A random forest localizes multiple anatomical landmarks on head CT images; a heuristic search then uses these landmarks to estimate an initial point-based registration transform for image-guided cochlear implant programming
29250565.headline_result: Automated landmark-based initialization performed equivalently to manual initialization

26894329.clinical_problem: Improving the reliability of 2D/3D image registration used for daily patient setup verification in pediatric brain-tumor proton/external beam radiotherapy
26894329.patient_population: Six pediatric patients with brain tumors receiving proton therapy
26894329.model_description: A neural network pattern classifier ('registration quality evaluator') analyzes geometric features of daily orthogonal setup X-ray-to-CT registration solutions to automatically flag failed registrations for rejection and re-attempt
26894329.dataset_size: six pediatric patients, multiple registration trials each
26894329.headline_result: Sensitivity 0.865-0.964 and specificity 0.797-0.990 for detecting registration error >1mm; final acceptance ratio 92.4%
26894329.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and randomized controlled evaluation

26142928.clinical_problem: Stitching multiple overlapping fetal/obstetric ultrasound volumes into one accurate composite despite fetal movement
26142928.patient_population: Pregnant subjects (obstetric ultrasound); abdominal phantom for validation
26142928.model_description: A group-wise, block-matching non-rigid registration/mosaicing algorithm formulated as a Markov random field (with confidence maps for artifact-robustness) aligns and fuses multiple partially overlapping ultrasound volumes into one composite obstetric volume
26142928.headline_result: Fusion-based MRF registration produced accurate displacement fields much faster than standard approaches
26142928.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and phantom/clinical validation study

26152942.clinical_problem: Non-invasively distinguishing the three most common childhood posterior fossa brain tumors (medulloblastoma, pilocytic astrocytoma, ependymoma) from routine MRI
26152942.patient_population: 121 children diagnosed with medulloblastoma, pilocytic astrocytoma or ependymoma across three hospitals
26152942.model_description: 3D textural features computed from pre-contrast T1- and T2-weighted MRI are used to train an SVM classifier, evaluated by leave-one-out cross-validation, to classify the tumor type
26152942.headline_result: Good overall classification performance across scanners/field strengths (exact accuracy not given in abstract)

22723038.clinical_problem: Improving estimated fetal weight accuracy specifically for extreme macrosomia (>=4500 g) where standard formulas perform poorly
22723038.model_description: Sonographic biometric measurements (biparietal diameter, occipitofrontal diameter, abdominal diameters) are fit with a gradient-boosting regression technique to derive a new logarithmic estimated-fetal-weight formula for extreme macrosomia
22723038.headline_result: New formula had lowest mean absolute percentage error (2.506%) versus existing equations

17877822.clinical_problem: Generating prior probabilities of pediatric brain tumor type from anatomical location to improve MR-spectroscopy-based tumor classification
17877822.patient_population: Database of over 1,300 pediatric brain tumor cases collected over five decades
17877822.model_description: Belief networks built from a database of pediatric tumor cases generate a probability that a given tumor is each of several types (astrocytoma grades, ependymoma, PNET, germinoma, medulloblastoma, craniopharyngioma) based on anatomical location, combined with an MRS-based classifier
17877822.headline_result: Using network-derived prior probabilities improved classification accuracy compared with priors based on class prevalence alone

34512293.exclusion_reason: adult neuroscience review of parent-child interaction; not diagnostic imaging AI or radiology-focused

34706300.exclusion_reason: fMRI study of adult mothers viewing infant face images; no pediatric patients imaged, no AI/ML

32464497.exclusion_reason: conventional statistical modeling (finite mixture models) of radiation exposure risk; no AI/ML

34104876.exclusion_reason: gestational age estimation from newborn metabolomic blood markers; non-imaging

22529218.exclusion_reason: fMRI activation study in ADHD; no AI/ML classification, standard statistical analysis

40971485.exclusion_reason: survey of radiologists' attitudes toward AI; not a pediatric imaging application

39715692.exclusion_reason: dental/orthodontic CBCT tooth-movement study; non-radiologic dental imaging

39761112.exclusion_reason: dental caries diagnosis on radiographs; excluded dental imaging

39722253.model_family: random survival forest (with NLP feature extraction)
39722253.clinical_problem: Predicting whether and when a perimembranous ventricular septal defect will close spontaneously in children, to guide treatment timing
39722253.patient_population: 29,142 children with perimembranous VSD across six tertiary centers in China
39722253.model_description: Natural language processing extracts structured predictors (defect morphology, age, etc.) from free-text echocardiography reports and medical records; a random survival forest model uses these to predict occurrence and timing of spontaneous VSD closure
39722253.headline_result: Validation-set AUC 0.95 for 1- and 3-year predictions, 0.95-0.96 for 5-year; test-set AUC 0.95-0.98
39722253.study_design: multicenter retrospective model development and validation study

39806960.clinical_problem: Improving diagnostic accuracy of pneumonia detection on chest X-rays for deployment in resource-limited settings
39806960.patient_population: Chest X-ray dataset from Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center
39806960.model_description: CNN layers extract local image features which are combined with modified Swin Transformer blocks (window-based self-attention) to capture global context, classifying chest X-rays as normal or pneumonia
39806960.headline_result: Accuracy 98.72%, F1-score 0.9872 on an unseen test set

39812075.clinical_problem: Where deep learning currently stands for diagnosing, classifying, segmenting and predicting outcomes of pediatric solid tumors across radiology, pathology and other imaging
39812075.patient_population: Pediatric solid tumor patients across reviewed studies
39812075.model_description: Scoping review of 36 studies applying deep learning (classification, prediction, segmentation, synthesis tasks) to pediatric solid tumor imaging, 22 of them in radiology

39887783.clinical_problem: How AI can improve diagnosis, monitoring and risk stratification of fetal growth restriction
39887783.patient_population: Pregnancies complicated by fetal growth restriction
39887783.model_description: Narrative review of AI methods (automated fetal biometry, Doppler-index and maternal-characteristic predictive models) used to diagnose and monitor fetal growth restriction and stratify adverse-outcome risk

39919411.model_family: normalizing flow network + shallow harmonizer network
39919411.clinical_problem: Harmonizing brain MRI acquired across different sites/scanners without needing paired data or source-site access, evaluated including neonatal brain segmentation and neonatal brain age estimation
39919411.patient_population: Adult and neonatal brain MRI datasets
39919411.model_description: A normalizing-flow network learns the distribution of a source imaging domain; a shallow harmonizer network is trained (and updated at inference) to make new-site images match that learned source distribution, unsupervised and without needing source-site data at inference, tested on neonatal brain segmentation and brain-age estimation as well as adult brain MRI
39919411.headline_result: Superior performance compared with existing harmonization methods (exact metric not given in abstract)
39919411.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and cross-domain validation study

39944870.clinical_problem: Distinguishing bacterial pneumonia from Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia as the cause of pleural effusion in children using chest CT
39944870.patient_population: 535 hospitalized children with pleural effusion (167 bacterial, 368 Mycoplasma)
39944870.model_description: Radiomics features are manually extracted from non-contrast chest CT regions of pleural effusion, reduced by feature-selection methods (Select K Best, mRMR, LASSO), and input to a logistic regression model that classifies the effusion as bacterial or Mycoplasma pneumoniae-related

39946265.exclusion_reason: general neuroradiology review of 0.55-T MRI; not pediatric-focused, AI mentioned only in passing

39950139.clinical_problem: How accurately AI models estimate gestational age from ultrasound compared with the standard reference
39950139.model_description: Systematic review and meta-analysis pooling AI models (mainly CNNs) that estimate gestational age from 2D ultrasound images or blind-sweep video against ultrasound-based reference standards
39950139.headline_result: Pooled mean GA error 4.32 days (2D images) and 2.55 days (blind-sweep video)

39979183.clinical_problem: Robustly segmenting bone anatomy from 3D hip ultrasound to automate measurement of developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) metrics
39979183.patient_population: Pediatric patients (newborns to 6 months) undergoing 3D hip ultrasound for DDH evaluation
39979183.model_description: A 3D extension of the SegFormer transformer architecture, with hierarchically structured encoders producing multi-scale features, segments hip bone anatomy from 3D ultrasound volumes to compute DDH diagnostic metrics more robustly than CNN/ViT baselines
39979183.dataset_size: not stated exactly (clinical pediatric test set)
39979183.headline_result: Up to 0.9% improvement in Dice score and up to 3% smaller 95% Hausdorff distance vs. state of the art
39979183.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and robustness evaluation study

40159500.clinical_problem: Improving both explainability and accuracy of genetic-marker classification for pediatric low-grade glioma, the most common pediatric brain tumor, from MRI
40159500.model_description: A multimodal contrastive-learning architecture jointly trains on 3D brain MRI and radiology reports (plus tumor location) to learn MRI representations that are then used to classify pediatric low-grade glioma genetic markers, with attention maps for explainability
40159500.headline_result: 87.7% classification performance; 31.1% Dice overlap between model attention maps and manual tumor segmentation

40233539.clinical_problem: Improving objective diagnosis of autism spectrum disorder, which typically manifests in childhood, using resting-state functional MRI instead of subjective behavioral evaluation
40233539.patient_population: ABIDE-I, ABIDE-II and ADHD-200 public datasets
40233539.model_description: ASD-HNet hierarchically extracts features from resting-state fMRI functional brain networks at region-of-interest, community (K-means-clustered functional gradients) and whole-brain scales, using graph convolution, to classify ASD versus controls
40233539.release_evidence: The code is available at https://github.com/LYQbyte/ASD-HNet.
40233539.dataset_size: ABIDE-I, ABIDE-II and ADHD-200 datasets (exact n not stated)
40233539.headline_result: Outperforms existing baseline methods on ABIDE-I, ABIDE-II and ADHD-200 (exact accuracy not given in abstract)
40233539.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and public-dataset validation study

40307202.clinical_problem: Distinguishing refractory from drug-sensitive epilepsy in children using glymphatic-function and white-matter MRI markers
40307202.patient_population: 70 children with drug-sensitive epilepsy and 26 with refractory epilepsy
40307202.model_description: DTI-ALPS index, fractional anisotropy, mean diffusivity and nodal efficiency from multi-parameter MRI are combined into a machine-learning model, evaluated by five-fold cross-validation, to discriminate refractory from drug-sensitive pediatric epilepsy

40337862.exclusion_reason: maternal serum lipidomics biomarkers for cleft lip; non-imaging

40347042.model_family: supervised machine learning classifier + K-means clustering
40347042.clinical_problem: Explaining heterogeneous cortical-thickness findings in Juvenile Myoclonic Epilepsy by defining imaging-based endophenotypes and relating them to cognition and EEG
40347042.patient_population: 64 JME patients aged 12-25 and 41 age/sex-matched healthy controls
40347042.model_description: Data-driven comparison of cortical thickness and subcortical volumes between JME patients and controls; supervised machine learning confirms the classification power of these differences, and K-means clustering groups patients into imaging endophenotypes correlated with cognition and EEG
40347042.headline_result: Three discrete imaging endophenotypes identified (left, right, symmetric), with left-hemisphere disease linked to lower general cognitive performance
40347042.study_design: prospective cohort study (Juvenile Myoclonic Epilepsy Connectome Project)

40379941.clinical_problem: Whether AI models for pediatric wrist fracture detection perform as well on realistically difficult cases as on randomly sampled test cases
40379941.patient_population: Children with wrist radiographs from the open-source GRAZPEDWRI-DX dataset
40379941.model_description: EfficientNet (classification) and YOLOv11 (detection) models trained on pediatric wrist radiographs are evaluated on two different test-set sampling strategies (random vs. difficulty-balanced) to measure real-world performance drop
40379941.headline_result: YOLOv11 precision dropped from 0.95 (random test set) to 0.83 (balanced, harder test set)

40454939.clinical_problem: Whether a deep-learning thyroid-nodule malignancy model trained on adults performs well when applied to pediatric thyroid nodules
40454939.patient_population: 128 pediatric patients (mean age 15.5) with 156 thyroid nodules and histologic confirmation, from two institutions
40454939.model_description: A deep-learning model (AI-Thyroid), originally trained on adult ultrasound data, is applied to axial and longitudinal pediatric thyroid nodule ultrasound images to output a malignancy likelihood, compared against radiologist TIRADS scoring
40454939.headline_result: AUROC 0.913-0.929, sensitivity 78.7-89.4%, specificity 79.8-91.7%; outperformed ACR-TIRADS and K-TIRADS (p<0.05)

40491787.clinical_problem: Automating classification of hip displacement severity (normal/risky/dislocated) in children with cerebral palsy from migration percentage on pelvic radiographs
40491787.patient_population: 176 hips from 88 anteroposterior pelvic radiographs of children with cerebral palsy
40491787.model_description: A support vector machine classifies hip migration-percentage measurements from anteroposterior pelvic radiographs of children with cerebral palsy into normal, risky, or dislocated categories, compared against manual clinician evaluation
40491787.headline_result: Overall accuracy 92.9%, exceeding manual assessment consistency
40491787.study_design: retrospective model development and comparison study

40606385.clinical_problem: Developing an automated system to diagnose autism spectrum disorder in children from resting-state functional MRI
40606385.patient_population: 26 autistic children and 26 controls, aged 5-10 years
40606385.model_description: Features extracted from resting-state fMRI of children are classified as ASD or healthy control using SVM, random forest, KNN and artificial neural network algorithms

40651288.clinical_problem: Providing an interpretable ('white-box') pneumonia classification tool on pediatric chest X-rays so radiologists can trust and validate the AI's reasoning
40651288.patient_population: 5,856 CXR images from pediatric patients ages 1-5 years (public Kaggle dataset)
40651288.model_description: A Deformable Prototypical Part Network learns interpretable visual 'prototypes' in pediatric chest X-rays, and classifies images as normal, viral, or bacterial pneumonia while showing which learned prototypes and image patches drove each prediction, validated by an expert radiologist
40651288.headline_result: Accuracy 86%, precision 86%, recall 85%, AUC 93%; 3% improvement over original ProtoPNet
40651288.study_design: retrospective model development study with radiologist evaluation of interpretability

40687738.clinical_problem: How well AI-enabled prenatal ultrasound detects fetal congenital heart defects compared to human sonographers
40687738.model_description: Systematic review and meta-analysis of AI models trained on fetal cardiac ultrasound images/video to classify the heart as normal or abnormal / detect specific congenital heart defects
40687738.headline_result: Pooled sensitivity 0.89 and specificity 0.91 for normal vs. abnormal heart classification

40688631.exclusion_reason: NLP survey of cancer registry text mining; not image-based, not pediatric-specific

40697959.exclusion_reason: AI ultrasound diagnosis of thyroid follicular neoplasms; adult population, no pediatric indication stated

40806525.exclusion_reason: narrative review of neuro-oncology theranostics; pediatric CNS tumors mentioned only in passing, not pediatric-focused

40841295.clinical_problem: Automating chest CT scoring of structural airway damage (bronchiectasis, airway wall thickening, mucus plugging) in pediatric cystic fibrosis, replacing time-consuming visual PRAGMA-CF scoring
40841295.patient_population: 178 CF patients (363 chest CTs; 100 New Zealand/Australian, 78 Dutch)
40841295.model_description: An automated AI algorithm (PRAGMA-AI) analyzes inspiratory chest CT scans of children with cystic fibrosis to quantify percent bronchiectasis, percent disease, airway wall thickening and mucus plugging, validated against the visual PRAGMA-CF reference score
40841295.headline_result: Strong correlation with visual PRAGMA-CF for %bronchiectasis, %disease and %mucus plugging; weak correlation for %airway wall thickening

40863668.clinical_problem: Synthesizing what AI/ML applications across the perinatal continuum (fertility, prenatal imaging, postpartum, neonatal care) have been shown to do, and their equity implications
40863668.patient_population: Reviews spanning reproductive, prenatal, postpartum, neonatal and early child development care
40863668.model_description: Scoping review of 39 reviews of AI/ML applications across perinatal care, including deep-learning fetal ultrasound anatomy segmentation and anomaly detection, gestational-age/fetal-weight prediction, and neonatal risk-prediction tools (e.g., sepsis, retinopathy of prematurity, necrotizing enterocolitis)
40863668.headline_result: Deep-learning fetal anatomy segmentation exceeded 90% overlap with expert annotation; anomaly detection sensitivity exceeded 93%

41050333.exclusion_reason: dental age estimation review; excluded dental imaging

41051700.clinical_problem: Whether contrast-enhanced ultrasound can safely and effectively assess placental perfusion in fetal growth restriction and preeclampsia, including emerging AI-based image analysis
41051700.patient_population: Preclinical animal models and 256 pregnant human subjects across reviewed studies
41051700.model_description: Narrative review of contrast-enhanced ultrasound for placental perfusion imaging, including emerging AI-enhanced (ensemble deep learning) quantitative analysis of CEUS images
41051700.dataset_size: 256 pregnant individuals across reviewed human studies
41051700.headline_result: Emerging AI-enhanced CEUS analysis achieves 73%-86% diagnostic accuracy in reviewed studies

41053269.exclusion_reason: MRI radiomics for hepatocellular carcinoma treatment response; adult population, no pediatric relevance stated

41058740.model_family: random forest (best of seven ML classifiers tested)
41058740.clinical_problem: Improving prediction of adverse perinatal outcomes in fetal growth restriction / small-for-gestational-age pregnancies by combining fetal MRI, ultrasound and clinical data
41058740.model_description: Twenty-seven features from fetal MRI, ultrasound and clinical data are used to train seven machine-learning classifiers (best: random forest) via 5-fold cross-validation to predict composite adverse neonatal outcomes and non-reassuring fetal status
41058740.headline_result: Random forest AUC 0.912 for composite adverse neonatal outcome, 0.834 for non-reassuring fetal status
41058740.study_design: single-center study with prospective FGR/SGA enrollment and retrospective controls

41122965.clinical_problem: Defining subtypes (endotypes) of bronchopulmonary dysplasia in preterm infants using advanced lung imaging, echocardiography and AI-based characterization, to enable precision therapy
41122965.model_description: Review of how advanced lung imaging, echocardiography, lung function testing and AI-based characterization can define airway, parenchymal and vascular endotypes of bronchopulmonary dysplasia to guide endotype-specific treatment

41136442.clinical_problem: Enabling accurate multi-institution AI models for medical imaging (illustrated on thyroid cancer ultrasound) despite heterogeneous data across sites, without centralizing patient data
41136442.patient_population: Multi-center thyroid cancer imaging study, including an out-of-distribution pediatric thyroid cancer cohort
41136442.model_description: A privacy-preserving distributed-learning framework (HeteroSync Learning) aligns representations across institutions via a Shared Anchor Task and an auxiliary learning architecture, tested on simulated data heterogeneity and a real-world multi-center thyroid cancer ultrasound study, including an out-of-distribution pediatric thyroid cancer test set
41136442.dataset_size: not stated exactly (multi-center thyroid cancer study)
41136442.headline_result: HSL achieved 0.846 AUC on out-of-distribution pediatric thyroid cancer data, outperforming comparators by 5.1-28.2%
41136442.study_design: retrospective multicenter method development and validation study

41141172.exclusion_reason: narrative review of AI fracture detection; general/adult-focused, pediatric only mentioned as a future direction

41166285.exclusion_reason: dental age prediction from panoramic radiographs; excluded dental imaging

38216974.model_family: electromagnetic navigation system described as 'based on artificial intelligence' (details not specified)
38216974.clinical_problem: Whether an AI-based electromagnetic surgical navigation system improves osteotomy accuracy during mandibular distraction osteogenesis for hemifacial microsomia in children
38216974.model_description: An electromagnetic tracking navigation system, described as artificial-intelligence-based, uses preoperative 3D CT scans and surgical plans to provide real-time guidance during osteotomy for mandibular distraction osteogenesis, compared to traditional (unguided) surgery

38312058.model_family: CNN (self-designed multi-input model; VGG16, ResNet50, Xception compared)
38312058.clinical_problem: Automatically discriminating active Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis from healthy joints using bone scintigraphy
38312058.patient_population: 326 healthy and JIA children/adolescents aged 1-16, 1,304 blood-pool scintigraphy images
38312058.model_description: A self-designed multi-input CNN, compared against pretrained VGG16, ResNet50 and Xception models, classifies blood-pool phase [99mTc]Tc-MDP bone scintigraphy images of knee and ankle joints as JIA-affected or healthy
38312058.headline_result: Self-designed model AUC 0.82 (knee), 0.86 (ankle); best pretrained model (VGG16) AUC 0.76-0.81

38347394.clinical_problem: Automatically detecting atrial septal defects in children from standard cardiac ultrasound video views

38347394.model_description: ResNet18 and r3D networks extract frame-level features from four standard pediatric echocardiographic views, aggregated via a multiple-instance-learning strategy into a video-level representation to detect atrial septal defect

38382384.model_family: deep learning (joint correlation learning with ranking regularization)

38382384.patient_population: 157 healthy fetuses between 22 and 34 weeks gestation (1,327 MRI images)

38528506.model_family: random forest (best of RF, LR, KNN, SVM, MLP)
38528506.clinical_problem: Objectively diagnosing neonatal respiratory distress syndrome from lung ultrasound, reducing reliance on operator-dependent visual interpretation
38528506.patient_population: 150 neonates with lung disease (60 NRDS, 30 each pneumonia/meconium aspiration/transient tachypnea) at a maternity and children's hospital

38528506.headline_result: Random forest AUC 0.99, not significantly different from experienced physicians (AUC 0.98, P=0.24) but significantly better than junior physicians (AUC 0.85, P<0.0001)

38558081.clinical_problem: Automatically detecting an increased nuchal translucency, a marker of genetic/structural fetal anomalies, on first-trimester ultrasound
38558081.patient_population: 560 fetuses between 11 and 13 weeks 6 days gestation, 88 with NT >3.5mm
38558081.model_description: A U-Net convolutional neural network segments the fetus and the nuchal translucency region on standardized mid-sagittal first-trimester ultrasound images, computing an NT:fetus ratio to flag thickened (anomalous) NT
38558081.headline_result: AUROC 0.96 for detecting thick NT on model segmentation; 94% sensitivity at 91% specificity

38604736.clinical_problem: Non-invasively predicting the molecular subtype (BRAF status) of pediatric low-grade neuroepithelial tumors from ADC MRI to guide targeted therapy without biopsy
38604736.patient_population: 299 children from one institution and 23 from a second institution with PLGNTs
38604736.model_description: Radiomics features extracted from semi-automated tumor segmentation on ADC MRI maps, combined with clinical variables (age, sex, tumor location), train multiclass random forest models to predict KIAA1549-BRAF fusion, BRAF V600E mutation, or non-BRAF molecular status
38604736.headline_result: Combined radiomics + clinical features AUC 0.77 (95% CI 0.75-0.77); per-class AUC up to 0.81 for KIAA1549-BRAF fusion

38615243.model_description: Diffusion basis spectrum imaging (DBSI) and 3D structural MRI features from 120 anatomical brain regions are combined using a multi-kernel support vector machine to classify preschool ASD versus healthy controls
38615243.headline_result: Highest single-model accuracy 86.88% (DBSI_20); combining all three models further improved performance

38617169.clinical_problem: Predicting MYCN copy-number status, a key prognostic marker, in pediatric neuroblastoma from 18F-FDG PET/CT rather than invasive biopsy
38617169.patient_population: 104 pediatric neuroblastoma patients with pathologic confirmation
38617169.model_description: PET/CT radiographic features, PET quantitative parameters and clinical/biological variables are combined via LASSO feature selection and multivariable logistic regression into bio-omics, radiomics and multi-omics models that predict MYCN wild-type vs. gain vs. amplification status
38617169.headline_result: Multi-omics model AUC 0.83 (95% CI 0.74-0.92) for MYCN wild vs. gain/amplification; AUC 0.95 for gain vs. amplification

38633090.exclusion_reason: OCT denoising in ophthalmic imaging; excluded retina/OCT imaging

38691204.clinical_problem: Predicting whether a child's hepatoblastoma will respond to neoadjuvant chemotherapy, using contrast-enhanced CT before treatment

38720865.model_family: feature pyramid network + Siamese contrastive learning
38720865.clinical_problem: Improving automated diagnosis of infant hip dysplasia across ultrasound images from different machines and infants, despite limited labeled data
38720865.patient_population: 493 infants imaged with various ultrasound machines
38720865.model_description: A semi-supervised method pretrains a Siamese-network feature pyramid on a large set of unlabeled infant hip ultrasound images via contrastive learning, then fine-tunes on a small labeled set to identify anatomical landmarks and recognize standard planes per Graf's method
38720865.headline_result: Mean Dice 0.7873 and Hausdorff distance 5.0102 for landmark identification; standard-plane recognition accuracy 95.4%

38739217.clinical_problem: Identifying resting-state brain-network alterations that distinguish depressed adolescents with non-suicidal self-injury with and without suicide attempts, to inform risk biomarkers
38739217.patient_population: 114 depressed adolescents (clinical controls, NSSI-only, NSSI+suicide attempt groups)
38739217.model_description: Resting-state functional connectivity features are classified with a support vector machine to identify convergent and divergent brain-network alterations distinguishing depressed adolescents with non-suicidal self-injury, with or without suicide attempts, from clinical controls
38739217.headline_result: SVM-based classification identified convergent limbic-network alterations across NSSI groups and divergent visual/subcortical alterations in the NSSI+SA group

38763411.exclusion_reason: fMRI study of neighborhood effects on reward processing in youth; standard regression analysis, no AI/ML model

38791871.exclusion_reason: scoping review of glioma imaging classification; only 8% of included studies were pediatric, not pediatric-focused

38871755.clinical_problem: Non-invasively predicting whether a pediatric brain glioma is high-grade or low-grade from multiparametric MRI to guide treatment planning
38871755.patient_population: 85 children with gliomas who underwent tumor resection
38871755.model_description: Radiomics features from multiparametric MRI (contrast T1, T2, FLAIR, DWI, ADC), combined with conventional MRI features and statistically significant clinical features, train AutoGluon automated-ML classifiers to grade pediatric gliomas as high- or low-grade

38883835.exclusion_reason: neurovascular coupling/neurotransmitter correlation study in amblyopia; no clearly described AI/ML method

38956718.clinical_problem: Automating 3D segmentation of Wilms' tumor and affected kidney on CT to enable routine 3D reconstruction without the time cost of manual segmentation
38956718.model_description: A CNN U-Net, including a version trained with the 'OV2ASSION' partial-manual-segmentation method, automatically segments Wilms' tumor and neoplastic kidney on pediatric CT scans
38956718.headline_result: Fully automatic U-Net Dice 0.69 (tumor)/0.27 (kidney); OV2ASSION method Dice up to 0.97 (tumor)/0.94 (kidney) with partial manual input, cutting expert time by 80%

38958680.model_family: deep learning-based attenuation and scatter correction (DL-ASC)
38958680.clinical_problem: Enabling sedation-free pediatric PET imaging by using ultra-fast total-body PET scanning with AI-based image correction instead of longer sedated scans

38958680.headline_result: No significant differences in qualitative scoring, lesion detectability or SUV between ultra-fast DL-ASC and standard imaging (P=ns)

39012407.clinical_problem: How emerging imaging technologies, including AI/ML, can address the unique challenges of imaging children compared with adults
39012407.model_description: Review of emerging pediatric radiology technologies (advanced ultrasound, CT, MRI, nuclear imaging, teleradiology, AI/machine learning, 3D printing, radiomics/radiogenomics) and their roles in addressing pediatric-specific imaging challenges

39028804.model_family: YOLOv5 with efficient channel attention (CNN object detector)
39028804.clinical_problem: Objectively and quickly detecting and classifying fetal cleft lip on prenatal ultrasound
39028804.model_description: A modified YOLOv5 model with an efficient channel attention module (Yolov5-ECA) detects the fetal lip region on ultrasound images and classifies it as normal or abnormal (cleft lip)

39085749.clinical_problem: Validating a commercially available AI-powered bone-age analyzer against the Tanner-Whitehouse 3 method in Chinese children and adolescents
39085749.patient_population: 900 Chinese children and adolescents from 30 centers
39085749.model_description: A commercially available AI-powered X-ray bone-age analyzer, using a deep-learning automated bone-age-assessment system, estimates TW3 radius-ulna-short-bone and carpal bone age from hand-wrist radiographs, compared with expert and resident raters

39085749.headline_result: TW3-RUS mean absolute error 0.48+/-0.42 years; TW3 carpal MAE 0.48+/-0.65 years, matching or exceeding doctor raters

39087230.clinical_problem: Comparing whole lateral cephalometric radiographs versus the cervical vertebral region alone for deep-learning bone age estimation in growing children
39087230.patient_population: 1,050 patients aged 4-18 years with same-day lateral cephalometric and hand-wrist radiographs

39087230.headline_result: The whole-cephalogram-trained model outperformed the cervical-vertebrae-ROI-trained model (exact error metrics not given in abstract)

39097613.model_family: three AI algorithms (architecture not specified) trained on disease-specific data

39252864.clinical_problem: Radiation-free screening and severity assessment of adolescent idiopathic scoliosis from a single smartphone photograph, instead of X-ray
39252864.patient_population: 2,397 patients with AIS and 48 potential AIS patients across four institutions
39252864.model_description: A conditional GAN (Swin-pix2pix) generates a virtual X-ray image from a single 2D RGB smartphone/camera photograph of a patient's back, which is then used to quantify Cobb angle, curve type and scoliosis severity

39252864.headline_result: Mean absolute Cobb angle error 3.2 deg (main curve)/3.1 deg (secondary) on prospective test set; severity-grading accuracy 0.93, exceeding two spine surgery experts
39252864.study_design: multicenter retrospective and prospective model development and validation study
